theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_ail_sqrt_det_second_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + t ^ 2 • S)))) 0 = Matrix.trace S
